2609.04901.title: Adaptation Interfaces for In-Context Tabular Foundation Models in Time-to-Event Prediction
2609.04901.paper_summary: Tabular foundation models (TabFMs) achieve strong performance on structured data, particularly for standard classification and regression problems. Yet, extending them to censored time-to-event prediction is challenging because it requires properly handling censoring and event-time dynamics. Building on our prior work, we further link TabFMs with CoxPH and DeepHit and revise the context-resampled training procedure. We evaluate temporal zero-shot reformulation, classification-based fine-tuning, and survival-head adaptation using frozen TabFM backbones on 74 single-risk data sets, and we additionally study 4 competing-risk data sets. Zero-shot inference is effective on smaller single-risk data sets, whereas supervised adaptation becomes increasingly advantageous as data sets scale. Cox provides the most reliably strong interface, especially for Integrated Brier Score (IBS) on larger data sets. DeepHit is relatively stronger for the time-dependent Concordance Index than for IBS, while cause-specific MTLR ranks highest among the TabFM survival heads in the four-data-set competing-risk analysis. Classification fine-tuning becomes more competitive with zero-shot inference as data sets grow but remains weaker for probabilistic prediction. Overall, our results indicate that effective TabFM transfer depends on the data regime and on the statistical structure represented by the chosen adaptation interface. The implementation scripts used for this work are available at https://github.com/kaylode/survival-fm.
2609.04901.paper_summary_zh: 表格基礎模型（TabFMs）在結構化數據上表現出色，特別是在標準分類和回歸問題上。然而，將它們擴展到被審查的事件預測是具有挑戰性的，因為這需要妥善處理審查和事件時間動態。在我們之前工作的基礎上，我們進一步將TabFMs與CoxPH和DeepHit聯繫起來，並修訂了上下文重採樣的訓練程序。我們在74個單風險數據集上評估了時間零樣本重構、基於分類的微調和生存頭適應，並且我們還研究了4個競爭風險數據集。零樣本推斷在較小的單風險數據集上是有效的，而隨著數據集的擴大，監督適應變得越來越有利。Cox提供了最可靠的強接口，特別是在較大數據集上的綜合Brier分數（IBS）。DeepHit在時間依賴的和諧指數方面相對較強，而在四個數據集的競爭風險分析中，特定原因的MTLR在TabFM生存頭中排名最高。隨著數據集的增長，分類微調在零樣本推斷中變得更具競爭力，但在概率預測方面仍然較弱。總體而言，我們的結果表明，有效的TabFM轉移取決於數據制度和所選適應接口所代表的統計結構。用於此工作的實現腳本可在https://github.com/kaylode/survival-fm獲得。
